description: This file defines the FilterThemeHooks class for Drupal, implementing theme hooks and preprocess functions related to filtering and text formatting in Drupal's theming system.

classes.name: FilterThemeHooks
classes.description: Defines theme hooks and preprocess functions for filter-related templates in Drupal.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Implements hook_theme() to define theme hooks for filter tips, text format wrapper, filter guidelines, and filter caption.

methods.name: preprocessFilterGuidelines
methods.description: Prepares variables for filter guidelines templates, adding tips and format ID.

methods.name: preprocessTextFormatWrapper
methods.description: Prepares variables for text format wrapper templates, managing ARIA descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessFilterTips
methods.description: Prepares variables for filter tips templates, initializing attributes and handling multiple tips.
